tei:div.tei:p: bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyir yang theg pa che chung gi chos thams cad nas bla ma gal che bas mtshan nyid dang bsten tshul mang du gsungs/ sdong po bkod pa las/ skya ba 'dzin pa med pa yis/ /gru 'di pha rol phyin mi nus/ /yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang / /bla ma med pas srid mthar min/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'jig rten pa'i yon tan rigs mtho ba la sogs pa rdzogs pa'am/ yang na sgrub pa po slob ma'i yon tan dad pa dang / brtson 'grus la sogs pa rdzogs pa yod kyang rgyud byin gyis rlob pa'i bla ma ma bsten par rtogs pa mi skyes te/ de ma skyes na 'khor ba las mi thar bas bla ma dam pa bsten dgos la/ de'i mtshan nyid kyang / bla ma'i mtshan nyid brgyud par ldan/ /rtogs pa yod na tshad ldan yin/ /ces rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa bar ma chad par byang chub kyi sems la nges pa brtan po yod pa jo bo'i bka' brgyud lta bu la bsten dgos/ de bsten pa'i tshul yang gnyis las/ dang po don gyi sgo nas bsten pa ni/ bla ma'i gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin sgo gsum gyis bsgrub pa yin/ gsang ba brda'i sgo nas bsten pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'am spyi gtsug tu bla ma bsgoms nas mos gus byas gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ de la sbyor ba dngos gzhi mjug gsum las/ sbyor ba la gnyis las/ dang po sems bskyed pa/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ gnyis pa stong ra bcas/ rang lus snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bsam/ snying 'od kyi gong bu lta bur bsam/ dngos gzhi ni/ spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang gang mos kyi bla ma bsam/ de sngar mthong ma mthong gi bye brag gi sku'i tshad ji tsam yin pa la tshon gang tsam du bsam/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dang sku'i bzhugs tshul dang / gsung gi nga ro dang / thugs kyi dgongs pa thams cad dran par bya/

brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas la thug pa man chad chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / yi dam dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang bla ma de dang ngo bo tha mi dad par mos pa bya/ mchod pa ci 'byor dbul/ de nas thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la skyabs 'gro ci nus bya/ de'i don yang skyon thams cad dang bral ba/ yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ don dam par rang bzhin med pa nam mkha' lta bu yin yang bdag cag sems can thams cad kyi don du snang ba yin snyam du bsam/ de nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi rgyud la ji ltar 'khrungs pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyud la ji ltar mnga' ba/ nges don gyi mdo sde rnams kyi brjod bya'i don gyi mthil byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis bdag gi rgyud la da lta nyid du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'byor ba/ rgud pa/ mtho ba/ dma' ba/ bde ba/ sdug pa/ na ba/ 'chi ba/ 'pho ba/ skye ba'i dus thams cad du byang chub kyi sems mngon du gyur par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rkyen dang bar chad thams cad chos 'di'i grogs su 'khyer shes par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ de nas mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya bcas la tshangs phug kha phye bar bsam/ de'i nang na mar bla ma'i sku 'od kyi rnam pa skar mda' 'pho ba'i tshul du byon nas snying du zhugs par bsam/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos rang 'di yin snyam pa'i dad gus skyes tshad gcig bsgom/ de nas khong glod la bla ma'i sku gsung thugs rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du gyur par bsams la gnas tshad du bzhag /gsum pa rjes ni/ de la mi gnas na rang gi lus dang snying ga'i bla ma sngar bzhin bsam/ yang na spyi bo'am/ rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/

dus gsum gyi dge ba thams cad bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / chos 'di skye ba'i ched du bsngo ba dang / smon lam btab/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa la brten nas phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / mdor bsdus na thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i phan yon gnyis 'byung / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'tshe ba thams cad kyis mi tshugs/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thob/ gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa thams cad 'byung / dmigs pa gnyis kyi bye brag gis 'od gsal la 'pho ba yin pas/ 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag 'di nyid yin/ 'di la 'bungs na rang gang 'dod kyi rtogs pa 'char nus gsungs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rtogs pa gzhan mi dgos gsungs/ rin po che spyil bu ba'i zhal nas/ nga'i snying phyung nas bstan kyang sha dmar lhog lhog pa kham gcig las mi gda'/ nyams len gyi mthil phyung ba 'di yin gsungs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bla ma'i gsung las yi ge bkod pa'o/ /chos 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phags pa byams pa la/ des thogs med la/ des dbyig gnyen la/ ku sa li che ba/ ku sa li chung ba/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje lha gcig /dge bshes ston pa/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ spyil bu ba/ slob dpon lha/ lha gding ba/ dbon/ dharma sid+dha/ rgya ston byang chub rgyal mtshan/ mkhan po gzhon nu byang chub/ rin chen 'byung gnas dpal bzang po/ des bud+dha rat+na/ des kīrti shī la la/ des dza ya bha dra/ des puṇ+ya rat+na la'o// //sarba he 'dzum// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
